title: Magnetic Field Conforming Multiscale Formulations for Locally-Confined Nonlinear Eddy Current Problems Using the FE-HMM Method
summary: Magnetic composites used for the conversion of electrical energy often incorporate ferromagnetic inclusions insulated from each other to mitigate eddy current losses. Numerical models for these composites must be robust enough to address potential convergence issues arising from the presence of nonlinear magnetic inclusions and presence of significant confined eddy currents in the cell. This paper introduces an $\mathbf{h}$-conforming multiscale formulation for magnetic composites in a periodic framework.
